      Company and to the non-controlling interests                  非控股權益為赤字結餘。
      even if this results in the non-controlling interests

                Business combinations                                              業務合併


                A business is an integrated set of activities and                  業務為一組綜合活動及資產，
                assets which includes an input and a substantive                   包括一項輸入及一個實質流
                process that together significantly contribute                     程，且 兩 者 可 為 創 造 輸 出 的 能
                to the ability to create outputs. The acquired                     力 作 出 重 大 貢 獻。倘 所 收 購 流
                processes are considered substantive if they                       程對持續生產產出的能力至
                are critical to the ability to continue producing                  關 重 要，包 括 擁 有 執 行 相 關 流
                outputs, including an organised workforce with                     程 所 需 技 能、知 識 或 經 驗 的 有
                the necessary skills, knowledge, or experience to                  組 織 員 工，或 對 持 續 生 產 產 出
                perform the related processes or they significantly                的 能 力 有 重 大 貢 獻，且 被 視 為
                contribute to the ability to continue producing                    獨 特 或 稀 缺，或 在 持 續 生 產 產
                outputs and are considered unique or scarce                        出的能力方面沒有重大成本、
                or cannot be replaced without significant cost,                    努力或延遲的情況下無法被
                effort, or delay in the ability to continue producing              替 代，則 所 收 購 流 程 被 視 為 實
                outputs.                                                           質性。

                Acquisitions of businesses, other than business                    收 購 業 務（共 同 控 制 下 的 業 務

            The measurement of ECL is a function of                      預期信貸虧損之計量為

            (i.e. the magnitude of the loss if there is a                違 約 時 虧 損 大 小）及 違 約

            of ECL reflects an unbiased and probability-                 預估乃無偏概率加權平
            weighted amount that is determined with the                  均金額，以各自發生違約

            weights. The Group uses a practical expedient                團使用可行權宜方法，運
            in estimating ECL on trade receivables and                   用撥備矩陣預估應收貿
            finance lease receivables using a provision                  易賬款之預期信貸虧損
            matrix taking into consideration historical                  及應收融資租賃款項，當
            credit loss experience and forward looking                   中考慮過往信貸損失經
            information that is available without undue                  驗及毋須繁苛成本或工
            cost or effort.                                              作即可獲得之前瞻性資
                                                                         料。

            Generally, the ECL is the difference between                 一般而言，預期信貸虧損
            all contractual cash flows that are due to the               為根據合約應付本集團
            Group in accordance with the contract and                    的所有合約現金流與本
